product_summary: Mumbai-based bearing supplier/manufacturer (own site: incorporated 2012, directors Sanjay Shah and Komal Sanjay Shah; office at Parekh Chambers, 127 Sheriff Devji Street, Masjid Bandar West, Mumbai 400003). Real product lines per adarshbearings.com: (1) Ball bearings — deep groove single/double row, angular contact (single/double row, four-point), self-aligning, miniature, precision, stainless steel, thrust ball → HS 8482.10; (2) Tapered roller bearings — single row, double row (TDO/TDI), four-row, matched/split, e.g. type 30205 → HS 8482.20 (matches declared code); (3) Spherical roller bearings → 8482.30; (4) Needle roller bearings → 8482.40; (5) Cylindrical roller bearings → 8482.50; (6) Linear motion bearings, rod-end bearings, other special (high-temperature, ceramic/hybrid) → 8482.80; (7) Pillow block / housed bearing units → 8483.20; (8) Bearing parts/bushes → 8483.30; (9) Bearing fitting toolkits (mechanical pullers/fitting tools) → 8205.59; (10) Adarsh-brand greases: BSG 3 Plus, BSG 222, Chuck, HTHP, Food grease → lubricating greases HS 2710.19 (not bearings at all). Site also lists 'OEM Bearings' and country landing pages (Russia, Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia) under an 'Export' menu item.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — site claims own manufacturing/OEM capability and 'Adarsh' brand, but simultaneously describes itself as 'wholesale supplier', 'distributor', 'bulk supplier' and sells via IndiaMART, Amazon, Moglix and GeM; a Mumbai Masjid Bandar office address (a trading/distribution cluster) with no plant address published is a trader sign. Mixed manufacturer-trader profile.
comment: HS 848220 (tapered roller bearings) is CORRECT but covers only one of at least ten product lines — status partial, not wrong. Per project rule 3 the company is kept and the code list is corrected/expanded rather than rejected. Industry misclassification: declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong — the company is a bearings/lubricants manufacturer-trader (HS ch. 84/27); mining and rolling mills appear only as END-USER industries on the site, not as its own output. Product lines missing from the declaration: ball bearings (8482.10), spherical (8482.30), needle (8482.40), cylindrical (8482.50), other/linear/rod-end (8482.80), housed bearing units (8483.20), bearing parts (8483.30), fitting toolkits (8205.59) and greases (2710.19) — the grease line is a separate, non-bearing commodity and would need its own HS line if shipped. Trader signs: 'wholesale supplier', 'distributor', 'bulk supplier', multi-marketplace resale (IndiaMART/Amazon/Moglix/GeM), no factory address published. All product claims above are from the company's own website (adarshbearings.com home, /about/, /ball-bearings/, /tapered-roller-bearings/, /adarsh-grease/) — no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. The export country pages (Russia, Tanzania, Kenya, Zambia) are marketing landing pages only; the /export/ URL returned 404 and no shipment record was verified here — export activity is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Registries, revenue and customs volumes were out of scope for this task and are not assessed.
